restoredContributions: The first addition restores concrete, explicitly conditional mechanisms by which defeat might become an enduring political relation, while preserving the original limit that the route in each case remains unknown.

The second addition restores the conditional examples of geographically uneven and temporally inconsistent implementation; both sentences use ‘might’ and do not turn the proposal into proven practice.

The third addition restores the useful temporal distinction between conquest’s concentrated encounter and administration’s repeated arrival, and its placement after the discussion of message speed gives it a clear argumentative bridge.
scope: Nonblind follow-up checking three restorations; no new literary score
